column3: NASB ends the sentence at “the Book of the Kings of Israel,” making “Judah” the subject of the next clause; the Hebrew can be read either way.
“Temple servants” renders the Hebrew term for the Nethinim.
NASB reads “Bani” (reading tradition); the written text differs slightly.
The Hebrew reads “Hassenuah” with the article; NASB keeps “Hassenuah.”
“Mighty men of ability” is rendered “very able men.”
NASB opens a parenthesis that runs into verse 18.
NASB supplies “being stationed” and closes the parenthesis; “camps” is rendered “camp.”
“In their faithfulness” is rendered “in their office of trust.”
“In faithfulness” is rendered “in an office of trust,” and “mighty ones” as “chief.”
“Over the key, and to the morning to the morning” is rendered “in charge of opening it morning by morning.”
“Articles” is rendered “utensils,” and NASB supplies “counted them … in.”
“Articles” is rendered “furniture … utensils,” and “holy place” as “sanctuary.”
